translation: The Yang Qiao is the bie (divergent) vessel of Foot Taiyang; its vessel arises in the middle of the heel and emerges below the outer ankle at the Shenmai point (BL62) of Foot Taiyang (in the depression five fen below the outer ankle, [large enough] to hold a fingernail, at the border of the white flesh). At the ankle it rounds behind the heel, taking Pucan as its root (in the depression below the heel bone, obtained by arching the foot). Ascending three cun above the outer ankle, it takes Fuyang as its xi (cleft) point.
